description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kawarakkulama, Mahavanna Maduwa, Poni Mankulama, Thammennewa, Nuwaragam Palatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110186 and Others.
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed information about land parcels, ownership details, property extents, and legal encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
